notes: deterministicPerformance: Per-query algorithmic work is constant with fixed dimensionality; size-scaled wall-clock batches are informational rather than a blocking complexity gate.
Ray/AABB slab queries are checked against independent face-plane enumeration on generated fixtures.
Ray/sphere cross-product line-distance queries are checked against an independent quadratic oracle.
Direction magnitude is metamorphically tested from subnormal through maximum finite f32 values.
criterion: Divan ray_queries benches run directly through cargo bench; constant-time query complexity does not need a size-dependent operation-count gate.
deterministicPerformance: Per-query algorithmic work is constant with fixed dimensionality; size-scaled wall-clock batches are informational rather than a blocking complexity gate.
Moller-Trumbore ray/segment-triangle queries are checked against an independent plane-intersection and signed-area oracle on 8,192 generated fixtures.
Fixtures cover front/back faces with and without back-face culling, inclusive edges and vertices, parallel and coplanar rays, degenerate triangles, distance bounds and segment endpoints.
Direction magnitude and triangle translation are metamorphically tested; an allocation ratchet proves the queries allocate nothing.
criterion: Divan ray_queries benches include hit-heavy, mixed and miss-heavy ray_triangle batches; wall-clock timing is informational.
deterministicPerformance: Per-query algorithmic work is constant with fixed dimensionality; size-scaled wall-clock batches are informational rather than a blocking complexity gate.
Generated sweeps compare with an independent time-domain quadratic oracle.
Velocity scaling preserves contact position while inversely scaling time.
Starts-overlapping, stationary, receding and bounded-window cases are explicit.
criterion: Divan ray_queries benches include sphere-sweep batches; wall-clock timing is informational.
